steps.title: Verify the project
steps.subtitle: Lint, 467 automated tests and the simulator's calibration gates

commands.caption: One command re-checks the whole project: linter, test suite, and calibration against published churn benchmarks.

steps.title: The founding experiment
steps.subtitle: A good churn model, used to target offers, loses money

commands.caption: AUC 0.700, yet an offer to its top 20% loses 22,823, worse than random (-17,035). Oracle rows use true effects: an upper bound.

steps.title: Raw input: a billing export
steps.subtitle: Stripe-shaped CSV files with amounts in cents, as Stripe exports them

commands.caption: Writes a Stripe-shaped export: random rows, fixed seed.
Plan Amount is in cents: 18922 means 189.22.

steps.title: Preflight refuses an unsafe file
steps.subtitle: Reading cents as currency would overstate every revenue figure 100x

commands.caption: BLOCKED: whole-number amounts look like cents. It asks the business; it does not guess.
Exit code 1, so an automated pipeline stops here.

commands.cmd: python -m retainiq.cli autopsy --customers demo/customers.csv --subscriptions demo/subscriptions.csv --out demo/blocked.html
commands.caption: Asking for the report anyway: it stops.

steps.title: Units confirmed: report and worklists
steps.subtitle: The same export, with amounts divided by 100

commands.cmd: python -m retainiq.cli autopsy --customers demo/customers.csv --subscriptions demo/subscriptions.csv --divide-amounts-by 100 --interval month --name "Acme Analytics (demo data)" --out demo/demo_autopsy.html --worklists
commands.caption: READY: a median of 153.12 a month is plausible. The report and two worklists are written.
Worklists are descriptive follow-up lists: no risk scores, no predictions.

steps.title: Did it work? Measuring honestly
steps.subtitle: A randomised holdout, validated against the simulator's known effect
